cards.front: Which nutrient helps the body grow and repair itself?
cards.explain: Pulses, milk, eggs and paneer are rich in proteins.

cards.front: What colour does iodine solution turn when added to starch?
cards.explain: This is the test for starch.

cards.front: Lack of vitamin C causes which disease?
cards.explain: Scurvy causes bleeding gums. Citrus fruits and amla prevent it.

cards.front: Lack of iodine causes which disease?
cards.explain: Goitre is a swelling of the thyroid gland in the neck. Iodised salt prevents it.

cards.front: Which of these is rich in carbohydrates?
cards.explain: Rice, wheat and potatoes are rich in carbohydrates, which give energy.

cards.front: What is the smallest whole number?
What is the smallest prime number?
cards.explain: 2 is also the only even prime number.

cards.front: What is the HCF of 12 and 18?
cards.explain: Factors of 12: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12. Factors of 18: 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18. The highest common one is 6.

cards.front: What is the LCM of 4 and 6?
cards.explain: Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12… Multiples of 6: 6, 12… The lowest common one is 12.

cards.front: Is 1 a prime number?
cards.explain: A prime has exactly two factors. 1 has only one factor.

chapters.title: The Earth in the Solar System

cards.front: Which is the largest planet in the solar system?
Which planet is closest to the Sun?
Which imaginary line divides the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
Which planet is called the Red Planet?
cards.explain: Iron oxide in its soil makes Mars look red.

cards.front: How long does the Earth take to go once around the Sun?
cards.explain: One revolution makes a year. One rotation on its axis makes a day.

cards.front: A word that describes a noun is called a …?
Find the pronoun: She is my friend.
cards.explain: A pronoun takes the place of a noun.

cards.front: Find the adverb: He ran quickly.
cards.explain: An adverb tells us how, when or where something happens.

cards.front: Which word is a conjunction?
cards.explain: Conjunctions join words or sentences: and, but, because.

cards.front: Find the preposition: The cat is under the bed.
cards.explain: A preposition shows position: in, on, under, behind.
